newest.title: OpenAI’s New Clinical Agents: Can AI Actually Automate Your Healthcare Paperwork?
newest.description: OpenAI’s New Clinical Agents: Can AI Actually Automate Your Healthcare Paperwork. OpenAI just launched computer-use agents for healthcare, promising to handle actual clinical workflows rather than just answering questions. We’re breaking down if this is the productivity boost doctors need or just another layer of software to manage. What we covered: • OpenAI expands ChatGPT for Healthcare with computer-use agents and new clinical tools • Google adds Gemini-backed AI tools to AdMob for app developers • OpenAI broadens free frontier-model access for 200,000 researchers worldwide Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways. Listener question: If your doctor used an AI agent to handle your medical paperwork, would you be more concerned about privacy or more relieved by the efficiency? What to watch next: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules. Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next. What changed.
